sources.summary: England provides area-dependent river, sea and groundwater warnings by text, phone or email. Users can maintain their details, remove areas and delete an account. Surface-water flooding is outside this service.

The open API publishes warnings, areas, stations and observations. Readings change at most every 15 minutes; efficient clients request the latest batch. The API has no service-level guarantee and must not replace official safety-critical warning channels.

requirement.title: Civilian flood information and subscriptions
requirement.text: CIV-FLOOD-001 — Civilian flood information and subscriptions. F1: Give residents and civil authorities an understandable view of published flood warnings, affected areas and water observations, including source and observation time. F2: Support civilian oversight of the service. F3: Support area subscriptions and user-selected text, phone or email notification channels. F4: Let users update contact details, remove areas and delete accounts; state that surface-water flooding is outside scope. F5: Consume the latest observation batch at most every 15 minutes; show stale or unavailable data and retain the official warning channels. A1 (test design assumption): use a durable delivery queue, idempotent retries, protected subscriber details and an auditable delivery history. This supplementary information service is not a safety-critical replacement for official alerts.
